---
title: Ligurian Fish Soup
id: MAR-0123
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 25
difficulty: easy
---
## Ingredients
- 1 kg of small rock fish (scorpionfish
- to taste gurnard
- to taste red mullet
- to taste weever)
- 2 dl of tomato passata
- 2 tablespoons of chopped parsley
- 1 garlic clove
- 4 tablespoons of extra virgin olive oil
- to taste salt
## Method
1. Clean all the fish and keep them whole.
2. Pour one tablespoon of oil into a pan and arrange the fish in it.
3. Salt them lightly.
4. Crush the garlic with the appropriate tool and add it to the parsley, mix, and sprinkle the fish with the mixture.
5. Pour the remaining oil over them and let marinate for 2 hours.
6. Add the tomato passata, cover the pan, bring to a boil, adjust the flame, and let cook for about 6-7 minutes, until the fish are cooked.
7. Serve them in the cooking pan.
